# Waterskin (`equipment:waterskin`)
**Categories:** [Adventuring Gear](../equipment-categories/adventuring-gear.md) | **Cost:** 2 sp | **Weight:** 5 lb.

A Waterskin holds up to 4 pints. If you don't drink sufficient water, you risk dehydration (see “Rules Glossary”).
